title: Protein extraction, alkylation, and digestion for LC/MS of HEK-293
author: Shun Adachi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.h6gb9bw
materials: Quantify the proteins by using a Micro BCA Protein Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, U.S.A.).
Reduce the samples for 2 h at 37°C.
Trypsinize the resultant samples overnight at 35°C.
Quantify the amounts with the Pierce Quantitative Colorimetric Peptide Assay (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, U.S.A.).

steps.title: Wash harvested cells
steps.instruction: Wash approximately 10^6 harvested cells once in Krebs-Ringer-Buffer (KRB; 154 mM NaCl, 5.6 mM KCl, 5.5 mM glucose, 20.1 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 25 mM NaHCO3).

steps.title: Lysis and protein extraction
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 30 µl of RIPA buffer (NACALAI, INC., Kyoto, Japan), pass the suspension in and out through 21G needles for destruction, and incubate on ice for 1 h.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 10,000 g for 10 min at 4°C and collect the supernatants.

steps.title: Solidify and prepare samples
steps.instruction: Solidify the samples in acrylamide gel. For subsequent steps, use the XL-Tryp Kit Direct Digestion (APRO SCIENCE, Naruto, Japan).

steps.title: Wash and dehydrate samples
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes and drying of the samples.

substeps.instruction: Wash the samples in ultrapure water twice.
Wash the samples in dehydration solution three times.

steps.title: In-gel digestion and alkylation
steps.instruction: Process the samples using an In-Gel R-CAM Kit (APRO SCIENCE, Naruto, Japan) and perform alkylation.

substeps.instruction: Process samples using the In-Gel R-CAM Kit.
Alkylate the samples for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Post-digestion washing and drying
steps.instruction: Clean the samples after digestion and alkylation.

substeps.instruction: Wash samples with ultrapure water five times.
Wash samples with destaining solution twice.

steps.title: Peptide collection via ZipTip C18
steps.instruction: Collect dissolved digested peptides using ZipTip C18 (Merck Millipore, Corp., Billerica, U.S.A.).

substeps.instruction: Dampen the tips with acetonitrile three times.
Equilibrate tips with 0.1% trifluoroacetic acid three times.
Collect the peptides by performing approximately 20 cycles of aspiration and dispensing three times.
Wash the peptides with 0.1% trifluoroacetic acid three times (performed in two stages).
Elute by 0.1% trifluoroacetic acid / 50% acetonitrile using aspiration and dispense five times (each performed three times).

steps.title: Sample storage and preparation
steps.instruction: Store and prepare the finalized samples for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend samples in 0.1% formic acid before performing LC/MS.
